description: This Java source file implements the data access object (DAO) for handling 'OrderProductDownload' entities within the application's order module. It provides methods for fetching order product download records by ID and order ID, utilizing QueryDSL for constructing JPQL queries.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for OrderProductDownload, providing query methods to retrieve records based on ID and order ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderProductDownload entity by its ID, constructing a JPQL query with multiple joins to gather related entities.

methods.name: getByOrderId
methods.description: Fetches a list of OrderProductDownload entities associated with a specific order ID, using JPQL with joins.
